newsitem.title: USA: Time chairman Reginald Brack to step down in July.
newsitem.headline: Time chairman Reginald Brack to step down in July.

text.p: Time Warner Inc said Tuesday that Time Inc chairman Reginald Brack will step down from the position in July.
The position of chairman will be assumed by Time president and chief executive officer Don Logan, said Gerald Levin, chairman and CEO of Time Warner.

Brack, who will turn 60 on August 26, joined Time in 1962 as advertising salesman for Time magazine. He was named chief executive of Time Inc Magazine Co in December 1986. He became chairman and chief executive of Time from 1990 until August 1994, when he stepped down as chief executive.
In his term as chief executive, Brack is credited with having increased the number of magazines Time publishes from eight to 24.
